about: Custom Health Holdings Inc., an AI-enabled healthcare technology company that operates an infrastructure platform designed to ensure medication therapy works as intended. The company connects in-home technology, pharmacy, and pharmacist-led clinicians to create continuous visibility into a patient's therapy. Its AdhereNet platform operates an integrated pharmacy network across Canada and the U.S. supporting medication delivery, continuous monitoring, and clinical action to enable earlier engagement and support improved outcomes. The company serves payors, health systems, physician practices, community pharmacies, and primary care providers. Custom Health Holdings Inc. was formerly known as Queue Ventures Ltd. and changed its name to Custom Health Holdings Inc. in June 2026. The company was founded in 2021 and is headquartered in Brentwood, Tennessee.
